notes.title: Mark Hamill To Host ‘Thunderful World’ Digital Showcase on November 10th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37569367/892bc383a39eb0b46c5b4b09af85c4f9f1be9298.jpg[/img]

Hey friends,

we have some awesome news, which we can finally share with you today: We - that's Thunderful Games - welcome all of you to the premiere of our very first digital games showcase ‘[b]Thunderful World[/b]’! ːsteamhappyː

Find out more in the following press release:


[i][b]Gothenburg, Sweden - October 28th, 2021[/b] - International developer and publisher Thunderful Games, creator of the multi-award winning and multi-million selling SteamWorld franchise, is welcoming everyone to a new digital games showcase, ‘[b]Thunderful World[/b]’. The event will be taking place on [b]November 10th at 11am PT / 2pm ET / 7pm GMT / 8pm CET[/b], hosted by Hollywood and pop culture icon [b]Mark Hamill[/b]. Tune in to the livestream on Twitch, YouTube and the [url=https://thunderful.world/][b]thunderful.world[/b][/url] website.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37569367/8a01bc9ec10d1ba6e674354314fd34accd1fbb51.png[/img]

Tune in to see Mark delight us with a ton of exciting new game reveals and announcements from Thunderful. The event will deliver updates on exciting upcoming titles including the surprise indie hit of Summer Game Fest, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1608230/Planet_of_Lana/][b]Planet of Lana[/b][/url]. There will also be more news on Thunderful titles like [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1608550/Firegirl_Hack_n_Splash_Rescue/][b]Firegirl[/b][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1726120/Cursed_to_Golf/][b]Cursed to Golf[/b][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1315610/Source_of_Madness/][b]Source of Madness[/b][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1276660/Tinkertown/][b]Tinkertown[/b][/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1158890/White_Shadows/][b]White Shadows[/b][/url]. 

Alongside Mark’s headline hosting role, the event will also feature appearances from Thunderful Group CEO Brjánn Sigurgeirsson, Corporate Vice President at Xbox Sarah Bond, plus a few other surprise industry partners.

Thunderful is proud to be partnering with Xbox and The MIX for Thunderful World. To sign up for the event and be the first to know all the important information ahead of the show on [b]November 10th[/b], head over to [url=https://thunderful.world/][b]thunderful.world[/b][/url]. As your one stop shop for all things Thunderful World, the website will be updated with new announcements and reveals as the event unfolds.[/i]


Stay tuned and tune in on Nov 10th - see you all in the event!
Your Thunderful Games-Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6a Scarlet Update
notes.content:
Dear folks of Glome,

:focused:
Finally we caught all bug criminals that have been occurred the unexpected loading crash and memory leak. Sorry for this long update, but we had to test a lot of it with many different OS and devices, with many different suspicions and researches. It's very difficult to find the bug which the devs cannot detect their devices, it randomly generated, and we don't know what was the main cause.

...It was like your stomach is suffering and the reason why is from your little finger. Doesn't make sense, right?

The dark age is gone, and the devs can rest now. So, please enjoy the world of Glome!

Best Regards,
Minho.

I hope you enjoy the game.

- Minho Kim.

notes.title: Scarlet Hood and the Wicked Wood Out Now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=_eBFerc4sDI;full][/previewyoutube]

You read that right, folks! The wait is finally over. Scarlet Hood and the Wicked Wood is officially out on Steam! We put our heart and souls into this game over the past year and hope it can bring some entertainment your way. If you didn't catch it yet, we kicked off the celebration with the launch of the very special live-action trailer (above). 

Story
Scarlet Hood and the Wicked Wood is the story of a young woman who finds herself tossed into the magical realm of Glome by a rogue tornado. It is there she must take up the mantle of the “Red Witch” and learn to wield her powerful Womping Stick to help a troupe of lost Munchkin safely navigate their way through the perilous domain of the Black Witch, LeFaba. The evil sorceress has no qualms about destroying any unwary intruders that trespass in The Wicked Wood. While Scarlet may be completely outmatched, she soon learns a recursion hex has her reliving the same day. Can she use her newfound powers and the knowledge gained from her previous lives to outwit LeFaba and lead the troupe to safety?

Gameplay
Many of you may be wondering what to expect this time around. First off, this game is heavily story driven. If you like visual novels, you'll enjoy this. If you’re a fan of puzzle-solving/adventure games you’ll feel right at home in “The Wicked Wood” as well. This game has more puzzles than you can shake a stick at. There are multiple paths to success featuring 10 unique endings to be unlocked. But just because this game more heavily focuses on puzzles doesn’t mean that it skimps on action; you’ll have to avoid the bumbling Dodobo, mischievous Monkeyta, and a relentless wolf to survive this forest. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38872802/2dd8faa0995468add645e516c988e6c32ae000a1.jpg[/img]

Discord
Make sure to join our friendly Discord server for exclusive updates, to connect with like-minded gamers, and chat with the devs. We'll also be sure to nudge you in the right direction if you find yourself stuck on any of the puzzles too long. Click the image below to join the fun!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/devespresso][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38872802/2b6d16d2fbe5d54ff1e8ff624d478f4372de9b7a.jpg[/img][/url]

We're looking forward to meeting all of you!

notes.title: Scarlet Hood launch postponed to April 8th; no Early Acces anymore!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38872802/b58c610c6910176ad055cfe578c342cecd921d7a.jpg[/img]

Hello folks,

not long ago we announced February 10th as the Early Access launch date for [b]Scarlet Hood and the Wicked Wood[/b]. But we had to change our plans, and the game will now be released on [b]April 8th[/b].

Contrary to the Early Acces planning we will release the game in its entirety at launch rather than several sections unveiled over time. The game will launch with seven languages in addition; English, Korean, German, French, Russian, Simplified Chinese, and Spanish.
 
For those who are disappointed with the delay, head over to the [b]Steam Game Festival February 2021 Edition[/b] starting today for our demo, and be the first to play the game! ːsteamhappyː

Please let us know your feedback and join us on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://t.co/AuMYsfSXwJ?amp=1][b]Devespresso Discord[/b][/url] or [url=https://discord.com/invite/headupgames][b]Headup Discord[/b][/url] and say "Hi!"!
